prompts.image: Generate ONE new photorealistic cinematic frame, landscape 16:9. Not a diagram. Image1 controls exact composition; image2 contains true projected mesh boxes and vanishing points; image3 face identity; image4 ONLY burgundy robe, gold embroidery, white undershirt, black lapels and truck materials, ignore its pose/background; image5 authentic distant Poznan railway materials. Camera outside left cab window of burgundy gold GRUZAR G84 mixer, travelling on solid concrete road viaduct 8.6m ABOVE tracks. Blue dusk, warm cab practical. Driver faces LEFT strict profile, lips closed, two hands naturally gripping a physically connected side-view steering wheel. SCALE IS CRITICAL: head SMALL x33–43%, vertical 14–34% INCLUDING hair. Head must not become a portrait. Wheel x13–26%, vertical 40–70%. Opaque BLACK BACK of near mirror x0–14%, vertical 13–70%; do not show reflective glass. Preserve the vast empty black cab space behind driver: rear window pillar x73–77%, not x60%. Window frame geometry exactly image1, lower sill as image1. Three identical LARGE black speaker cones in a single chrome column at extreme right x89–100%, vertical spacing around 25% image height, cropped naturally at borders; never four small cones. Cream drum behind column. Driver wears same robe/white undershirt/silver chain. Through far window, platform canopy ROOFS and parallel tracks are far BELOW camera. Horizon y34%. Plain solid concrete parapet, NO metal railing on top. No close station facade, trees at window height, feather, extra people, written captions, guide lines, watermark. Real surfaces, no low-poly buildings. All objects use same perspective as image1. This is a new photograph from original references, not an edit. MANDATORY FOREGROUND OCCLUDER: broad BLACK MIRROR BACK rectangle x0–14%, y13–70%, left edge cropped, clearly visible IN FRONT OF the window and dashboard. Do not omit it. Sill near y85%, not y75%. Do not print truck model text inside the lower door because it lies below this crop. Driver head center x38%.
prompts.endFrameDescription: Wspólna klatka graniczna f0289; dokładne zakończenie segmentu i początek następnego.
prompts.animation: 0-3s: Move around the cab front corner in one exterior tracking arc, from the side window to the frontal grille. The driver and window leave view as the rigid front grille fills the right foreground. Traffic moves continuously nose-first along the lanes relative to the fixed road; visible wheels roll, lane spacing stays constant. No vehicle stops for the camera. Preserve truck fittings, lettering, lights and vehicle proportions. Camera motion continues through both boundaries, reaching the supplied End Frame at 3s. Keep architecture rigid and dusk exposure stable. No feather, cuts, dissolves, morphs or new people. @Image1: the same mixer design only; retain the Start/End crop and visible fittings. @Image2: the existing driver's face and hair only; keep his robe from Start/End.
